summary: Round 38 recheck, 10:15-10:40Z 29 Sep (13:15-13:40 MSK). Sources: local files plus one local CPU dummy-lab run on the exp89t dummy CSV. 0 Kaggle calls, no browser. The lens is saturated (140 earlier items), so I picked the three closed items that today's new facts touch and that bear on the two remaining steps: the exp89t read (~17:50-19:54Z) and the finals tick by 20:00Z. The new facts are Satwik's 744273 claim, the 09:19Z exp89r read, the rank-in-block position, and a never-computed dummy-lab score for exp89t. (A) Running-champion conservative reading (02:02Z (2)), with R36-RC-C(b)'s 'DIS prior ~0, the two labs disagree': UPHELD, now with numbers. exp89t's dummy lab is +0.00089 over exp87a, all of it from the node-count bonus (same TP/FN, 1 FP fewer). An MC conditioned on the three night displays gives public DIS of +0.0003 given an UP and -0.0001..-0.0003 given k = 0. So the rule keeps exp87a exactly where DIS is on average negative. P(0.960) is only 0.01-0.08, and P(0.959 + UP) is 0.14-0.47. (B) Satwik's 'public LB has very few divisions' revives v3's 'division knobs invisible on public' and the non-x138 'diverse F2': NOT SUPPORTED as stated. Probe 26 shows the division term is worth ~0.036 on public (J_pub ~0.36). But each +0.001/+0.002 fork-set read is only 1-2 fork events. That is exactly why the partner (#37 or exp75, neither with cap 6 or K) is insurance. No non-x138 final. The optional Satwik card line at 12:03Z should be reworded. (C) The #38 no-insertion partner (R20-RC-C 'obsolete at cap >= 6'), re-derived for today's V_pub (cap 6 + K + CI): UPHELD. #37 or exp75 beats #38 iff the BASE insertion is positive on private (P 0.80-0.90). Satwik's null is about marginal forks, not the base. No build, no dummy, no slot: slot 2 stays on the user's 12:00Z hold (default UNUSED).

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION. The 02:02Z (2) running-champion rule, CONSERVATIVE READING: a later file at the champion's display replaces it only with an attributable UP (k >= 1). k = 0 / MASKED / BLIND keeps the champion, because 'an unresolved tie carries no evidence that the later file is better'. R36-RC-C(b) put the DIS 2.25 prior at ~0 because two labs disagree: exp13 old lab -0.0007 (S* ~1.66) versus dummy lab +0.0005 on K. R37 rejected any exp89t rule change as post-hoc. WHAT CHANGED: (1) exp89r read 0.957, and the additive DIS estimate is 0 +- 0.001-0.002. (2) Our row is 16th of 20 in the 0.959 block (post_exp75 save, ranks 125-144, 4 teams below us), so exp87a's unrounded score likely sits in the lower half of [0.9585, 0.9595). (3) NEW MEASUREMENT: exp89t's dummy CSV (the 08:59Z PASS) had never been scored in the dummy lab. exp89t = 0.91764 vs exp87a 0.91675, so DIS on K+CI = +0.00089 (44b6 +0.00082, 6bba +0.00089). Per clip, edge TP/FN and division counts are identical, FP drops 93 -> 92 on 6bba_05db0fb1, and total_node_ratio falls on all 4 clips (44b6_0b24845f -0.385 -> -0.401). The whole gain is the node-count bonus from -0.77% nodes. The other DIS arms are: on K +0.00048, on K+SEC +0.00039, on exp70g -0.00079 (1 TP lost). The lab's pre-score exp89r prediction (R36-RC-A: 0.958 central, range 0.957-0.959) held at the low edge (0.957). CHECK (MC, 4M draws, conditioned on exp85a 0.958, exp89p 0.956, exp89r 0.957; CI N(+0.001, 0.0004), SEC N(-0.0017, 0.0006), SEC x CI +0.0004; gap to the next team ~Exp(5e-5); three DIS priors; exp87a uniform in the block or at its block position Beta(5,16)). P(exp89t 0.960) = 0.01-0.08. P(0.959 with UP) = 0.14-0.47. P(0.959, k = 0) = 0.23-0.40. P(<= 0.958) = 0.18-0.56. Mean public DIS is +0.00025..+0.00033 given an UP and -0.00009..-0.00031 given k = 0. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD. The conservative reading sorts the cells correctly: it promotes exp89t only where public DIS is positive, and the only out-of-public instrument (dummy lab, 4/4 correct signs on non-coordinate levers counting exp89r) is also positive on this base. The mechanism is the node bonus, which does not depend on the embryo. Staying on exp87a at k = 0 gives up at most ~+0.0001-0.0002 in expectation. R36-RC-C(b)'s '~0' should read 'mildly positive on the K+CI base (dummy lab +0.0009, node bonus only); public posterior ~0'. Its (a) 'a 0.960 would be mostly exp87a's rounding' is weaker now: P(0.960) is small either way.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSIONS. (i) v3 FINAL_REPORT (i) said division knobs are 'invisible on public' (~5 evaluable forks). R15-RC-A overturned this for DC-gated forks (probe 41 -0.005) and kept it only for insertion-marginal forks. (ii) The 'diverse / non-x138 F2' finals idea (v2 finals-emax-diversify, v3 C02) is closed: R15-RC-C, R33-RC-A (premium ~+0.0002) and R11-RC-C (no x138 byte copy). WHAT REVIVES THEM: at 744273 (~09:08Z), Satwik (#411) wrote 'I believe the public LB has very few divisions'. His division changes with consistent local gains gave 0 or a slight drop on the LB, and he guesses the x138 family 'might fall apart on private'. R37-A4 turned this into an optional card line: 'if so, cap 6 and K were tested on an easy embryo'. CHECK against our own public record. (1) The division term on public is large, not small. Probe 26 (exp29 0.947 -> exp45 with safe divisions OFF 0.911; RESULTS.md l.59) gives 0.1 x div_J_pub = 0.036, so J_pub ~0.36 (pawanmali saw the same). Fork-set levers also move the display: DC 0.30 -0.005 (probe 41). By contrast, the 44b6-like lab reads fork-set levers as exactly 0 (R29-RC-C), so the public embryo is not a low-division embryo in that sense. (2) The quantization, however, is real. One fork event is worth 0.1/(TP+FP+FN), i.e. ~0.0007-0.002 for a denominator of 50-150. So each public fork-set step (+0.001 insertion, #35-#34 and #37-#38; +0.002 cap 4->6, probe 45; the ILP 0.4 half of K's +0.002, probe 50) is 1-2 events. SGHWR said as much ('swings on one or two forks'). (3) Every MARGINAL fork addition read 0 or -1 step: forkmid 0 (probe 42), DC 0.20/0.225 0 (43/44), cap6+thr0.3+forkmid 0 (46), cap 8/12 -0.001 (47/49). That matches Satwik's null, whose explanation is low marginal precision on an unseen embryo, not 'few divisions'. (4) 'x138 falls apart on private' gives no usable hedge. Our only non-x138 finals-grade files (exp51/exp52, 0.950) use the same pilkwang detector weights, were also public-tuned, and are 0.009 lower. NEW VERDICT: (i) stays overturned. Satwik's premise is not supported by our record, but his conclusion (public fork gains may not carry to private) is right for the 1-2-event steps. That is already insured: V_pub's two fork-set steps (cap 6, K) are exactly what both registered partners (#37, exp75) lack. (ii) stays closed. No build, no slot, no pair change.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION. R20-RC-C: 'keep #38 (no insertion) whenever the partner carries the insertion' is OBSOLETE for an F1 at cap >= 6; #37 (cap 4) is the better partner (derived for F1 = exp70g). Since then every registered partner (#37, exp75) carries the base DaughterNet insertion, as does V_pub, so no final is insertion-free. WHAT COULD REVIVE #38: (1) V_pub is now exp87a (cap 6 + K + CI; exp89t possibly + DIS), not exp70g. (2) Satwik and SGHWR (744273) say division additions with local gains do not transfer, which argues for insuring the insertion itself. RE-DERIVED for the current V_pub. Let x be the private effect of the base insertion (cap 0 -> 4) and W the private effect of everything else V_pub adds (cap 4 -> 6, K, CI, [DIS]). Then max(V, #37) - max(V, #38) = x + max(W, 0) - max(x + W, 0). This is >= 0 whenever x > 0 (the gain is min(x, -W) when W < 0) and <= 0 whenever x < 0. The same holds for exp75 with W' = W - CI. So the choice depends ONLY on the sign of the base insertion on private, and W's size does not matter. The evidence on x is unchanged and is not what Satwik's null is about. It comes from the honest OOF v1 insertion (135 videos, old base): +0.0019 overall, 44b6 +0.0015, 6bba +0.0021; added-fork precision 0.27 (Wilson 80% [0.15, 0.43]) vs a break-even of 0.11-0.20. There are also two public +0.001 reads of the same mechanism (#35-#34, #37-#38). Satwik's and our own nulls (forkmid, DC relax, cap 8/12) concern MARGINAL forks, which belong to W, not x. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD. P(#37 or exp75 better than #38) = P(x > 0) ~0.80-0.90, and the loss when x < 0 is bounded by |x| (~0.001-0.002). #38 stays out of the finals.
